title: Comet Heap

reward.description: A shard of ice that refuses to melt. It glows faintly whenever someone nearby is in a hurry.

hints: Store the heap in self.items. For the item at index i, its parent is at (i - 1) // 2 and its children at 2 * i + 1 and 2 * i + 2.
push: append to the end, then 'bubble up': swap with the parent while it's smaller than its parent.
pop: remember items[0], move the LAST item to index 0, then 'sink down': swap with the smaller child while a child is smaller.
